svg.text: The threshold stays above half the owners. At least two keys can go missing.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: No one person and no one kind of key reaches the threshold; always-online wallets together stay below it.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Every change is one Safe transaction, approved on the consoles with a 3 s hold on a red page.
